races.paceDynamic: Dos Mukasan is the only confirmed front runner in this 14-runner handicap, likely to get an uncontested lead with Collecting Coin, Key Witness and several other prominent runners settling just behind. The moderate early pace will allow the large contingent of hold-up horses including Gleneagle Bay, Final Voyage, Aviatrice and Dark Viper to get into contention turning for home. With one leader and multiple closers, this sets up perfectly for the hold-up brigade who can unleash late runs on yielding ground that typically favours strong finishers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Dos Mukasan sets modest fractions and the field stays bunched
scenarios.body: The yielding ground and sedate pace allows closers to quicken decisively in the final two furlongs. Multiple hold-up horses can deliver telling challenges with Gleneagle Bay and Final Voyage best positioned to capitalize.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens after halfway with prominent runners pressing
scenarios.body: Key Witness and Collecting Coin can capitalize on their forward positions while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground. The stronger gallop plays to their tactical advantage over the soft surface.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Dos Mukasan gets very easy fractions and kicks clear early
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage before the closers can organize their challenges. His stamina and rating prove decisive despite carrying top weight.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If the field crawls through the middle stages in single file
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint finish where any horse with a turn of foot can win regardless of style. This creates chaos and allows outsiders to emerge from impossible positions.

watchPoints.text: Gleneagle Bay could be overbet given his excellent recent Curragh second and proven finishing kick on this ground

Dos Mukasan will get an easy lead but his recent form suggests he may not handle the step up in class
Aviatrice returns after six months off but showed smart form before the break and yard overdue a winner

races.paceDynamic: Royal Bay Cen, Tornado Kiss, Bear On The Run and Rosie Frith will ensure a genuine gallop from the off in this small but competitive field. With four confirmed leaders among just 10 runners, the pace will be strong throughout, creating stamina pressure over this testing 5½f trip on soft ground. The prominent runners like Havana Anna, Ipanema Queen and Thenandnow face congestion issues in the middle stages. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can capitalize on the inevitable pace collapse, with Oh Cecelia perfectly positioned to exploit the scenario.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the four leaders go too fast early and tire from 2f out
scenarios.body: The strong gallop will stretch the field but ultimately backfire as stamina tells on the testing ground. Oh Cecelia's hold-up style becomes the winning move as she powers through tired horses in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Havana Anna and Ipanema Queen avoid the early traffic and track the pace
scenarios.body: The class pair can position perfectly behind the speed battle without getting involved early. Their superior ability allows them to strike decisively when the leaders weaken approaching the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders breaks clear and avoids the pace duel
scenarios.body: Royal Bay Cen or Tornado Kiss could steal a march if they get first run while the others battle. The winner would need to find extra stamina reserves to hold off the late closers on this testing surface.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners get badly hampered by the pace congestion
scenarios.body: With 4 of 10 wanting prominent positions, interference becomes likely in the crucial 2-3f out zone. A horse getting a clean run from an unpromising position could capitalize on others' misfortune.

races.paceDynamic: Happy Pharoah stands as the sole confirmed front-runner in this 19-runner field and will dictate terms from the outset without pace pressure. With most runners adopting prominent or hold-up tactics, Happy Pharoah can set a controlled gallop that suits his rhythm through the first mile. The lack of genuine pace angles means the tempo will be steady rather than searching, creating a tactical affair where positioning and timing become crucial. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track Happy Pharoah and hold-up horses with tactical speed, as they'll benefit from the controlled pace and have most options in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Favours Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Happy Pharoah sets uncontested fractions and the pace stays steady throughout
scenarios.body: The measured gallop will suit hold-up horses with tactical speed who can finish strongly. Late runners like Comfort Zone, Zoffman, and Navy Waters get ideal conditions to unleash their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays controlled but prominent runners get first run on Happy Pharoah
scenarios.body: Those tracking the leader can strike first and hold on, with the measured early pace leaving them with enough in reserve. Taipan, Helvic Dream, and Kilmeaden are perfectly positioned to capitalize.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Happy Pharoah Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Happy Pharoah's controlled pace proves too tactical and no horse can reel him in
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader maintains his rhythm throughout and proves too strong, especially with his proven ability at this trip. His quality edge shows when others struggle to make up ground on the testing surface.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If Happy Pharoah goes too slowly and creates a sprint finish from the back
scenarios.body: The race becomes a cavalry charge where positioning matters less than raw finishing speed. This chaotic finish could see any hold-up horse prevail if they find gaps.

watchPoints.text: Happy Pharoah's early fractions are crucial - if he goes too fast or slow it changes everything for the entire field
Watch for Comfort Zone and Navy Waters getting good early positions as hold-up horses need to avoid being too far back in this big field
Zoffman dropping significantly in grade with headgear change could be well-treated if the pace sets up right
Several runners returning from breaks need to show early that their fitness is adequate for this competitive handicap
The apprentice riders on Happy Pharoah, Helvic Dream, and others need to judge the pace correctly in this tactical affair

races.paceDynamic: L L Koulsty stands alone as the confirmed early leader with seven prominent runners likely to track closely behind, creating a competitive pace from the start. The strong contingent of prominent racers including Harmani, Jojo's Legacy, Kalir, and Coincidental Glory will ensure L L Koulsty cannot steal an easy lead, while the hold-up quartet of Matilda Joslyngage, Bear Right, Grey Intentions, and Arctic Assassin may struggle to get into contention on the tight Cork circuit. This pace scenario clearly favors prominent runners who can secure good early positions without having to make ground from the back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If L L Koulsty sets steady fractions with the prominent pack applying measured pressure
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair where those tracking the leader can pounce in the final furlong. Hold-up horses like Arctic Assassin and Matilda Joslyngage find too much traffic on Cork's tight layout.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leader Kicks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If L L Koulsty gets soft fractions early and quickens approaching the final furlong
scenarios.body: The prominent runners fail to apply enough pressure early, allowing the leader to build an unassailable advantage. Hold-up horses never get the strong pace they need.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack goes too hard trying to pressure L L Koulsty in the middle stages
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes unsustainably strong, setting up the race perfectly for the closers. Matilda Joslyngage and Arctic Assassin can capitalize with their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses
scenarios.trigger: If L L Koulsty goes too slow early and the prominent runners are caught napping
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the two-furlong marker where any horse can win. Grey Intentions' tendency to fade becomes less relevant in a slow-run affair.

watchPoints.text: L L Koulsty breaking clear in the early stages could steal this if the prominent pack allows soft fractions

Arctic Assassin getting squeezed for room on the tight Cork bends when trying to make his challenge

races.paceDynamic: Zitkala Sa and Aravalli will contest the early lead in this maiden fillies event, with both showing confirmed front-running tendencies from their recent efforts. The honest gallop they create should establish a solid tempo over this extended 1m2½f trip on yielding ground that will test stamina reserves. With most of the field holding up or racing prominently, the race will develop into a tactical affair where positioning entering the straight becomes crucial. This pace scenario strongly favours hold-up horses who can stay the trip, as the early pace will soften up the leaders for a late challenge.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the front runners maintain a solid gallop and weaken in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The honest early pace will set up perfectly for closers who can stay the extended trip, with the yielding ground adding to the stamina test. Late runners with proven ability will have first run on tired leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes stop-start with the leaders going too slow early
scenarios.body: Horses tracking the pace will be perfectly positioned to kick clear before the hold-up brigade can get organized. The lack of early pressure allows prominent racers to have enough left for a sustained drive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays On
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders gets an easy time in front with moderate fractions
scenarios.body: Either Zitkala Sa or Aravalli could dictate terms if their rival fails to engage, allowing them to control the race and find extra when challenged. The extended trip may not be enough to catch a filly with a soft lead.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the debutantes possess significantly more ability than their experienced rivals suggest
scenarios.body: One of the unraced fillies could have natural talent that overcomes their inexperience, particularly with strong jockey bookings like Seamie Heffernan. The maiden nature of the race leaves room for an unexposed talent to emerge.

Keep an eye on Seamie Heffernan's ride on debutante Palina as top jockey bookings on newcomers often signal stable confidence

Watch for early market support for any of the four unraced fillies as connections will know more about their home work

races.paceDynamic: Frank Pickle will lead from the front with minimal pressure, as most rivals are hold-up horses who prefer to come from behind. Sunrush and Dreamed To Dream may sit prominent but both have stamina concerns, while the majority including Hard Promises, Atomic City, Maxminelli, and Roaming Coyote will track from midfield or further back. This creates a tactical scenario where Frank Pickle can dictate terms unopposed through steady fractions before the field closes late. The race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those with early pace, as they can position close to an uncontested leader rather than relying on traffic-dependent finishing kicks from the rear.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Frank Pickle gets an easy lead and maintains energy for the finish.
scenarios.body: The proven front-runner controls the tempo completely and has enough left to repel late challenges from hold-up horses who face traffic problems. His recent Cork form and tactical advantage make him difficult to peg back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses get clear runs and Frank Pickle's stamina cracks.
scenarios.body: The backmarkers time their runs perfectly as Frank Pickle weakens in the final furlong, with class horses like Hard Promises or Atomic City producing sustained finishes. Fresh legs overcome tactical positioning.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Sunrush or Gaelic Drills press Frank Pickle early and inherit the lead.
scenarios.body: The pace quickens sufficiently to crack Frank Pickle's stamina, but not enough to completely favour the hold-up brigade. A horse sitting second or third throughout gets first run on the field.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Frank Pickle goes too slow early and multiple hold-up horses get perfect runs.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace sets up a sprint finish where the strongest finishers from deep positions can unleash devastating late kicks. Class and finishing speed triumph over tactics.

watchPoints.text: Frank Pickle's early fractions - if he goes too fast early he becomes vulnerable to late closers
